Definition: a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth
BiblicalUsage: This is the half of the Manahethites, a clan division listed among the sons of Salma with Bethlehem and the Netophathites. The name marks a family split in two, half reckoned here and half elsewhere.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts half-clans as carefully as whole tribes, and no family is too small to be named in the line.
